Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string set to RFT in the constructor.
Token name string set to 'Rocket Fuel Token' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable, set in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
SafeMath function adding two uints and requiring no overflow.
SafeMath function subtracting two uints and requiring b <= a.
SafeMath function multiplying two uints and verifying the result.
SafeMath function dividing two uints and requiring a non-zero divisor.
Owned contract constructor assigning msg.sender to owner.
Owner-only function storing a pending new owner address.
Pending owner claims ownership; performs an access-control check on msg.sender.
Token constructor minting the full supply to a fixed address and initializing token metadata.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance for a given token owner.
ERC20 transfer from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath.
ERC20 approve setting allowed[msg.sender][spender].
ERC20 transferFrom spending allowance and moving balances.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender.

Payable fallback function that always reverts to reject ETH.

Caller-controlled address used for balance debits, allowances and ownership checks.

Unsigned division c = a / b in safeDiv, protected by a non-zero divisor require.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) inside approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary contract.
Explicit revert() executed by the payable fallback function.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Constructor writes the caller-controlled address into owner, defining the access-control root.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
owner state variable gates transferOwnership through the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, an access-control check on the caller.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner and clears newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts who may call transferAnyERC20Token.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled state lookup.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender externally.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed mint amount.
Constructor credits the full supply in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply for its return value.
safeAdd performs the unchecked-pattern addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs the multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the division c = a / b.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
approveAndCall executes an external call to the spender-controlled receiveApproval function.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Fallback function always executes revert().

Parameter a is an operand of safeDiv.

Parameter b is an operand of safeDiv.

tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping.

spender parameter is stored as allowance and used as the external call target.

to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter flows into the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic of transfer.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance in approve.
tokens parameter flows into the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic of transferFrom.
tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded externally in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
from parameter indexes the balances and allowed mappings in transferFrom.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter determines the external contract that is called.

Local variable c stores the result of the safeSub subtraction.
Local variable c stores the result of the safeMul multiplication.
Local variable c stores the result of the safeDiv division.

normalization_plan.reason: Operand parameter a only exists to feed the SafeMath arithmetic operations and should be normalized into the enclosing arithmetic function.
Operand parameter b only exists to feed the SafeMath arithmetic operations and should be normalized into the enclosing arithmetic function.
_newOwner is a temporary parameter that is immediately stored into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner is only used as a mapping key for balance/allowance lookups and can be folded into the view functions.
spender is only used as an allowance mapping key and external call target, so it collapses into the approve logic.
to is only used as a mapping key for the balance credit and can be folded into transfer.
tokens is the amount operand of the arithmetic path and should be normalized into the transfer flow.
from is only used as a balances/allowed mapping key inside transferFrom.
data is an opaque payload forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress solely determines the target of the external contract call.
c is the temporary return variable of the SafeMath arithmetic operations.
balance is the local return slot of balanceOf.
remaining is the local return slot of allowance.
success is the boolean return slot of the transfer/approve family.
